name: Koil Energy Solutions, Inc.
summary: Koil Energy Solutions, Inc., headquartered in Houston, Texas, operates as a specialized energy services firm, delivering essential equipment and comprehensive support to the energy and offshore sectors. Founded in 1997 as Deep Down, Inc., the company rebranded to Koil Energy Solutions Inc. in April 2022. The company's extensive service portfolio encompasses intricate engineering and project management for subsea operations. This includes the full lifecycle management of subsea equipment and systems, from design and installation to retrieval, alongside critical connection and termination operations, well-commissioning, and robust construction support. Further augmenting its offerings, Koil Energy provides spooling services, rigorous testing and commissioning, efficient storage management, and the crucial refurbishment and repurposing of retrieved subsea assets. They also extend vital support for offshore intervention activities. Beyond services, Koil Energy supplies specialized hardware, including loose steel tube flying leads and umbilical products, in addition to riser isolation valves and related subsea isolation valve services. To facilitate complex offshore endeavors, the company furnishes a broad array of installation aids such as flying lead installation systems, tensioners, lay chutes, buoyancy modules, clump weights, mud mats, pumping and testing skids, control booths, fluid drum carriers, under-rollers, carousels, running and parking deployment frames, termination shelters, pipe straighteners, subsea deployment basket systems, horizontal drive units, and rapid deployment cartridges. Koil Energy's diverse client base includes energy corporations, subsea equipment manufacturers and installers, offshore drilling contractors, engineering and construction firms, and various other entities engaged in maritime operations.
